products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates lmarena.ai, a community-driven platform for evaluating and ranking large language models, image models, and code models. The site describes itself as offering an official AI ranking and LLM leaderboard where users can chat with models, compare outputs side by side, and vote on results, with those votes contributing to a public leaderboard shaped by real-world use. User conversations and certain personal information are disclosed to the relevant AI providers and may be made public to support research, and prompts may also be reused in automated evaluation to score and compare models.

The organization is structured as a nonprofit and tracks one product, LMSYS Arena Models, characterized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency rather than production deployment. No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are on file for the organization.
